top_signal.title: Shopify store owners, what actually worked for you when you were just starting out?
top_signal.summary: Hey everyone! I run a small Shopify store where I sell shirts featuring my own designs. Right now, I'm getting fewer than 20 visitors a day, and some days I get no traffic at all.   I've been doing my research on improving SEO, setting up Google Search Console, and experimenting with Google Ads on a small budget.   I'm trying to figure out what actually works instead of just throwing money at ads and hoping for the best.   I'm not really the influencer or content creator type, but I'm starting to realize that social media might be something I need to get more comfortable with.   Since my store isn't profitable yet, I can't afford to spend much on advertising or influencer collaborations.   For those of you who started from scratch, what actually helped you get your first consistent traffic and sales? Did you focus on SEO, organic social media, paid ads, or something else?   And once you started seeing results, what did you do to grow and scale?   I'd really appreciate hearing about your experiences, especially from people who started with little to no marketing budget. All the money I have saved for the business is for production cost.   Thanks!       submitted by     /u/Tossin_N_Turnin       [link]       [comments]
